brand.$description: RixDrive indigo. The platform admin app (apps/admin) deliberately does NOT use this ramp — it keeps a teal one of its own, so that an operator with both applications open is never in doubt which one they are typing into. Do not 'helpfully' sync them.

600.$description: Primary action ground under white text, and the focus ring. The dark value is a shade deeper so white on it still clears AA (5.77:1) while the ring still clears 3:1 against the dark plane.

link.$description: Accent TEXT — links, drill-throughs, the info badge tone. Separate from brand-700 because brand-700 is also the primary button's hover BACKGROUND and so cannot carry both jobs: a value light enough to read on the dark surface fails as a ground under white text. Light is brand-700, dark is brand-300.

surface.$description: The neutrals carry a trace of the brand hue rather than being pure grey. A neutral grey beside a saturated indigo reads as two unrelated palettes bolted together, and the shared hue is most of what makes a screen look designed rather than assembled.

subtle.$description: Measured against the darkest plane it lands on, not against white. This hue carries meta lines, figure hints and table headers, which sit on surface-2 and surface-3 far more often than on a card — a lighter value clears white at 4.69:1 and still fails there.

good.$description: Always paired with an icon and a label.

warning.$description: Sub-3:1 on light by design; icon+label is the mitigation.

serious.$description: Sub-3:1 on light by design; icon+label is the mitigation.

critical.$description: Unlike warning and serious, critical is NOT sub-3:1 by design — it was chosen to pass on white (4.80:1). It had no dark value, so it inherited the light one and measured 3.70:1 against surface-1 dark, failing AA for the most urgent text in the product. The dark value is the nearest red to the original that clears 4.5:1, measured rather than picked.

elevation.$description: Borders before shadows — rule 3. Flat is the default and a hairline is the first move; these three exist only for the cases where something genuinely floats above the page. A shadow tuned for white light is invisible on a dark plane, so the dark values are a deeper black rather than a darker grey.

$description: Source of truth. Style Dictionary generates the Tailwind theme, CSS custom properties and a TypeScript union from this file. No component ever contains a hex code. The series palette is validated for contrast and colour-vision deficiency against #FFFFFF and #16181D — re-run the validator if any hex changes.
